inventory.description: One nearly rectangular unbranched circuit. The top wire joins the upper coil lead on the left to the upper capacitor lead on the right. The bottom wire joins the lower coil lead to the lower capacitor lead. There are no junction dots, parallel branches, source/battery, resistance symbol, ground, meter, switch symbol or arrows.
topology: upper-left lead -> top wire -> upper-right lead -> upper capacitor plate
lower capacitor plate -> lower-right lead -> bottom wire -> lower-left lead
lower-left lead -> left coil -> upper-left lead
inventory.qualification: The two plates are separate conductors with an insulating gap, not a wire through the capacitor.

inventory.description: One vertical inductor symbol on the left branch, with four visible rounded left-facing lobes connected in sequence. Straight leads above and below join the loop corners. No iron core or secondary winding is drawn.
inventory.positions: Left branch between the upper and lower wires; all four lobes bow outward to the left.

inventory.description: One capacitor on the right branch, drawn as two thick horizontal approximately parallel plates of similar visible width. The upper lead meets the middle of the upper plate; the lower lead meets the middle of the lower plate. A white gap separates the plates.
inventory.positions: Right side, around the upper-middle height of the loop, opposite the coil.

inventory.description: No printed letters, numbers, given values, units, axes, ticks, phase markers, charge dots or field lines. Background is white and strokes are black with scan roughness.
inventory.visible_scan_artifact: A tiny pale break occurs along the lower capacitor lead; there is no blade/contact or annotation establishing a switch. Do not invent a switch from this raster defect.

unclear_facts.fact: Exact coil inductance, capacitance, wire dimensions and initial electrical state
unclear_facts.reason: No source labels or calibration supply these values; do not infer them.

inventory.description: Both curves share a single frame, not separate panels. A vertical axis lies at the left, extends below the origin and has an upward arrow. A horizontal time axis extends a little left of the origin and far right, with a right-pointing arrow. The scanned horizontal line is slightly slanted/uneven.

labels.position: Upper left of the vertical axis
Left and below the axes crossing; letter-shaped origin label
Below the horizontal axis near its right arrow

inventory.description: The visibly thicker solid oscillating curve is charge. Its upper-right leader joins its descending upper-right portion and points to the Chinese label '电量'. The curve begins on the vertical axis at a large positive ordinate, slopes downward, and has approximately constant repeating amplitude.

inventory.description: The visibly thinner oscillating curve is current. A lower-right leader joins a descending below-axis part of this thin curve and runs down-left toward the Chinese label '电流'. Most of the thin curve is continuous/solid; no regular repeated dash pattern is established by the original pixels.

inventory.qualification: There is a small local stroke interruption around the last downward crossing; scan/overprint roughness does not establish an intentionally dashed curve. Exact analytic amplitude and endpoint time cannot be recovered from this uncalibrated raster.

inventory.description: Current starts at zero while charge starts positive. As charge initially falls, current is negative. Current troughs occur near charge descending zeros; current crests near charge ascending zeros. Current zeros occur near charge extrema. The two curves repeat at the same visible period, with a quarter-cycle offset. There are roughly five visible mutual intersections in the interior.
inventory.sign_relationship: The initial current sign agrees with a derivative of the drawn decreasing charge, not with a positive sine beginning at the origin.
inventory.amplitude_qualification: The drawn positive/negative heights are broadly similar but carry no quantitative equal-amplitude statement.

inventory.description: Exactly two curve-name callouts, each with a plain connecting leader and no arrowhead: charge at upper right, current at lower right. No legend swatches, period symbol T, fractional-period ticks, equations, numeric calibration, extrema labels, queried-point markers, units or answer annotations appear.
